title: Data archive for "Scalable quantum simulation of continuous-time generative models via tensor networks"
description:
Hyperparameter-sweep outputs, trained velocity-potential checkpoints and per-cell run records generated and analyzed in the accompanying paper. Unpacks at the root of the code repository, where the figure and table generators read it.

Contents. Per-cell results for the d=2..8 orthogonal Gaussian-mixture sweeps (Dense, JAM, TCI+1TDVP, TCI+2TDVP, and the unreported TCI+ALS and ACI variants); the d=8..32 trained MPS-V trajectories behind Table 2; the theory CSV caches behind Figure 4; trained JAM checkpoints; and a MANIFEST.tsv giving the size and SHA-256 of every member.

Coordinate convention. Born-sample coordinates are stored node-centered, x = (i + u)·dx with u ~ U(-1/2, 1/2), matching the grid on which the wavefunction is represented. Each per-cell record carries an endpoint sliced-Wasserstein recomputed under that convention with a recorded projection seed (sw_endpoint), alongside the pre-correction values (sw_legacy_v1) so the difference is auditable. Records in earlier releases were dithered to the right of the node and carried a systematic +dx/2 offset per axis; scripts/migrate_archive.py in the code repository performs the conversion.

Verification. make verify-data in the code repository checks an unpacked copy against MANIFEST.tsv.
